content.title: Muslims Day Version 6.4.1 Is Here to Help You Organize Your Daily Acts of Ibadah!
content.subtitle: Let's take a look at what's new in this update.
content.body:
As you know, Muslims Day has been your companion in your journey of practicing Islam for nearly a decade, helping you become a better Muslim today than you were yesterday.

Continuing this journey, we've introduced several exciting features in the latest Android Version 6.4.1 to make your daily Islamic practices easier, more organized, and more meaningful.

Let's explore what's new!

1. Today's Amal (Daily Challenge): Build Consistency Through Small Acts

  • Where to find it: Scroll down a little on the app's Home screen to find the 'Today's Amal' card.

  • Features and Benefits: This feature allows you to track your daily progress in practicing good deeds, helping you build consistency through small, manageable actions.

  • Why it matters: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said: "The most beloved deeds to Allah are those that are done consistently, even if they are few." (Sahih al-Bukhari: 6464)
    This feature encourages you to develop a daily habit of performing good deeds, even if they are small, and maintain consistency in your journey of worship, In Sha Allah.

2. Qaza Tracker: Keep Track of Missed Prayers and Fasts

  • Where to find it: Go to the Features tab from the bottom menu and look for Qaza Tracker under the Tools section.

  • Features and Benefits: Based on your long-standing requests, we've introduced a dedicated tracker where you can separately record and update your missed prayers, from Fajr to Witr, as well as missed Ramadan and other obligatory fasts.

  • Why it matters: You no longer need a separate notebook to keep track of your missed prayers and fasts. Everything can now be organized in one place, making it easier to plan and complete your Qaza obligations, In Sha Allah.

3. Selected Articles: Valuable Insights to Become a Better Muslim

  • Where to find it: Go to the Features tab and look for Selected Articles under the Essential Islamic Knowledge section.

  • Features and Benefits: Even if you miss our daily informative push notifications due to a busy schedule or accidentally delete them, you can now access and read all the articles anytime in one convenient place.

  • Why it matters: These practical, life-oriented articles will add value to your daily life and inspire you to become a better Muslim today than you were yesterday, In Sha Allah.

4. Enjoy 7 Days of Premium Features for Free!

  • Where to find it: While logged out, go to the Others tab from the bottom menu. You'll find a button labeled "Log in to Start Your 7-Day Free Trial." Simply tap the button and log in to activate your free trial.

  • Why it matters: You can now enjoy all Premium features of Muslims Day for 7 days without paying any subscription fee, In Sha Allah.
